FROM customers c
JOIN products p ON c.product_id = p.product_id

GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name

WITH presence_deltas AS (
  SELECT HOUR(timestamp) AS log_hour,
         timestamp,
         CASE WHEN timestamp_type = 'Arrival' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END AS delta
  FROM employee_logs
),
running_occupancy AS (
  SELECT log_hour,
         SUM(delta) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS current_presence
  FROM presence_deltas
),
ranked_hours AS (
  SELECT log_hour,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY current_presence DESC, log_hour ASC) AS rnk
  FROM running_occupancy
)
SELECT log_hour
FROM ranked_hours
WHERE rnk = 1;

WITH moving_avg_calc AS (
  SELECT campaign_id, spend_date, spend,
         AVG(spend) OVER(
           PARTITION BY campaign_id 
           ORDER BY spend_date 
           ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
         ) AS moving_avg_3day
  FROM ad_spent
)
SELECT campaign_id, spend_date, spend
FROM moving_avg_calc
WHERE spend > 1.5 * moving_avg_3day;

CREATE TABLE stock_receivals (
            receival_id INTEGER,
            warehouse_id VARCHAR,
            medicine_id VARCHAR,
            receival_date DATE,
            units_received DECIMAL(10,2)
        );;
12.reference:
WITH peak_calc AS (
  SELECT medicine_id, warehouse_id, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS receival_date, units_received,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY medicine_id ORDER BY units_received DESC) as rnk
  FROM stock_receivals
),
moving_avg_calc AS (
  SELECT medicine_id, warehouse_id, CAST(receival_date AS VARCHAR) AS receival_date,
         ROUND(AVG(units_received) OVER(
           PARTITION BY medicine_id, warehouse_id 
           ORDER BY receival_date 
           ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
         ), 0) AS units_received
  FROM stock_receivals
)
SELECT medicine_id, warehouse_id, receival_date, units_received, 'peak_warehouse' AS insight_type
FROM peak_calc
WHERE rnk = 1

UNION ALL

SELECT medicine_id, warehouse_id, receival_date, units_received, 'moving_avg_3d' AS insight_type
FROM moving_avg_calc;

WITH all_routes AS (
  SELECT a1.airport_code AS origin, a2.airport_code AS destination
  FROM airports a1
  CROSS JOIN airports a2
  WHERE a1.airport_code <> a2.airport_code
),
all_combinations AS (
  SELECT r.origin, r.destination, c.class
  FROM all_routes r
  CROSS JOIN classes c
)
SELECT ac.origin, ac.destination, ac.class
FROM all_combinations ac
LEFT JOIN flight_inventory fi
  ON ac.origin = fi.origin
  AND ac.destination = fi.destination
  AND ac.class = fi.class
WHERE fi.flight_id IS NULL;

15.reference:
WITH annual_spend AS (
  SELECT YEAR(transaction_date) AS year,
         product_id,
         SUM(spend) AS curr_year_spend
  FROM user_transactions
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
lagged_spend AS (
  SELECT year,
         product_id,
         curr_year_spend,
         LAG(curr_year_spend) OVER(PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY year) AS prev_year_spend
  FROM annual_spend
)
SELECT year,
       product_id,
       curr_year_spend,
       prev_year_spend,
       ROUND(((curr_year_spend - prev_year_spend) / prev_year_spend) * 100.0, 2) AS yoy_rate
FROM lagged_spend
ORDER BY year ASC;

CREATE TABLE transactions_table (
            transaction_id INTEGER,
            merchant_id INTEGER,
            credit_card_id INTEGER,
            amount INTEGER,
            transaction_timestamp TIMESTAMP
        );;
16.reference:
WITH checked_repeats AS (
  SELECT transaction_id,
         transaction_timestamp, -- Added here so the outer WHERE clause can see it
         LAG(transaction_timestamp) OVER(
           PARTITION BY merchant_id, credit_card_id, amount 
           ORDER BY transaction_timestamp
         ) AS prev_timestamp
  FROM transactions_table
)
SELECT transaction_id
FROM checked_repeats
WHERE prev_timestamp IS NOT NULL
  AND transaction_timestamp <= prev_timestamp + INTERVAL 10 MINUTE;

WITH distinct_months AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
         user_id,
         CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', event_timestamp) AS DATE) AS m_date
  FROM events_table
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT user_id,
         m_date,
         LAG(m_date, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY m_date) AS prev_m1,
         LAG(m_date, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY m_date) AS prev_m2
  FROM distinct_months
)
SELECT CAST(m_date AS VARCHAR) AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS mau
FROM streaks
WHERE prev_m1 = m_date - INTERVAL 1 MONTH
  AND prev_m2 = m_date - INTERVAL 2 MONTH
GROUP BY m_date
ORDER BY m_date ASC;

WITH paired_swipes AS (
  SELECT employee_id,
         CAST(activity_time AS DATE) AS work_date,
         activity_type,
         activity_time AS login_time,
         LEAD(activity_time) OVER (
           PARTITION BY employee_id, CAST(activity_time AS DATE) 
           ORDER BY activity_time
         ) AS logout_time
  FROM swipe_logs
),
productive_calc AS (
  SELECT employee_id,
         work_date,
         SUM(
           CASE WHEN activity_type = 'login' 
                THEN EPOCH(logout_time) - EPOCH(login_time) 
                ELSE 0 END
         ) / 3600.0 AS productive_hours
  FROM paired_swipes
  GROUP BY employee_id, work_date
),
total_span_calc AS (
  SELECT employee_id,
         CAST(activity_time AS DATE) AS work_date,
         (EPOCH(MAX(activity_time)) - EPOCH(MIN(activity_time))) / 3600.0 AS total_hours
  FROM swipe_logs
  GROUP BY employee_id, CAST(activity_time AS DATE)
)
SELECT t.employee_id,
       CAST(t.work_date AS VARCHAR) AS work_date,
       ROUND(t.total_hours, 0) AS total_hours,
       ROUND(p.productive_hours, 0) AS productive_hours
FROM total_span_calc t
JOIN productive_calc p 
  ON t.employee_id = p.employee_id 
  AND t.work_date = p.work_date
ORDER BY work_date ASC, employee_id ASC;

CREATE TABLE car_listings (
            car_id VARCHAR,
            model VARCHAR,
            manuf_year INTEGER,
            km_driven INTEGER,
            base_price INTEGER
        );;
24.reference:
SELECT car_id,
       model,
       (2026 - manuf_year) AS age_years,
       km_driven,
       base_price,
       CASE 
            WHEN (2026 - manuf_year) <= 3 THEN 'New'
            WHEN (2026 - manuf_year) BETWEEN 4 AND 7 THEN 'Mid'
            ELSE 'Old'
       END AS segment,
       CASE 
            WHEN (2026 - manuf_year) <= 3 THEN 
                 CASE WHEN km_driven < 30000 THEN base_price * 1.20 ELSE base_price * 1.05 END
            WHEN (2026 - manuf_year) BETWEEN 4 AND 7 THEN 
                 CASE WHEN km_driven < 50000 THEN base_price * 0.95 ELSE base_price * 0.80 END
            ELSE 
                 CASE WHEN km_driven < 70000 THEN base_price * 0.70 ELSE base_price * 0.55 END
       END AS final_price
FROM car_listings;

25.setup:
CREATE TABLE payments (
            payment_id INTEGER,
            user_id INTEGER,
            mode VARCHAR,
            amount INTEGER,
            payment_date DATE
        );;
25.reference:
WITH running_spend AS (
  SELECT payment_id, user_id, mode, amount, 
         CAST(payment_date AS VARCHAR) AS payment_date,
         COALESCE(
           SUM(amount) OVER (
             PARTITION BY user_id 
             ORDER BY payment_date, payment_id
             ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
           ), 0
         ) AS prev_cum_spend
  FROM payments
),
breach_flags AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN prev_cum_spend >= 250 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_breached,
         LAG(CASE WHEN prev_cum_spend >= 250 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 1, 0) OVER (
           PARTITION BY user_id 
           ORDER BY payment_date, payment_id
         ) AS was_already_breached
  FROM running_spend
)
SELECT payment_id, user_id, mode, amount, payment_date,
       CASE WHEN is_breached = 1 AND was_already_breached = 0 AND mode = 'upi' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_cashback
FROM breach_flags
ORDER BY payment_id ASC;

WITH aggregated_stops AS (
    SELECT person_name, 
           floor_number, 
           COUNT(*) AS total_stops
    FROM elevator_stops
    WHERE person_name IN ('A', 'B')
    GROUP BY person_name, floor_number
),
ranked_stops AS (
    SELECT person_name, 
           floor_number, 
           total_stops,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY person_name ORDER BY total_stops DESC) AS rnk
    FROM aggregated_stops
)
SELECT person_name, floor_number, total_stops
FROM ranked_stops
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY person_name ASC;

WITH ranked_marks AS (
  SELECT class_id,
         subject_id,
         marks,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY class_id, subject_id ORDER BY marks ASC, student_id ASC) AS row_num,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY class_id, subject_id) AS total_count
  FROM student_marks
)
SELECT class_id,
       subject_id,
       AVG(marks) AS median_marks
FROM ranked_marks
WHERE row_num IN (FLOOR((total_count + 1) / 2.0), CEIL((total_count + 1) / 2.0))
GROUP BY class_id, subject_id
ORDER BY class_id ASC, subject_id ASC;

WITH distinct_user_months AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
           user_id,
           EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) AS month_idx
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_date >= CAST('2026-07-08' AS DATE) - INTERVAL 8 MONTH
),
consecutive_evaluation AS (
    SELECT user_id,
           month_idx,
           LEAD(month_idx) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY month_idx) AS next_month_idx
    FROM distinct_user_months
)
SELECT DISTINCT user_id
FROM consecutive_evaluation
WHERE next_month_idx = month_idx + 1
ORDER BY user_id ASC;

WITH user_first_orders AS (
    SELECT user_id,
           MIN(transaction_time) AS first_transaction
    FROM transactions
    GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(first_transaction, '%Y-%m') AS cohort_month,
       COUNT(user_id) AS new_users_count
FROM user_first_orders
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(first_transaction, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY cohort_month ASC;

CREATE TABLE orders (
            order_id INTEGER,
            city VARCHAR,
            customer_id INTEGER,
            order_date DATE,
            price DECIMAL(10, 2)
        );;
33.reference:
WITH monthly_orders AS (
    SELECT city,
           MONTH(order_date) AS order_month,
           COUNT(order_id) AS total_orders
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY city, MONTH(order_date)
),
lagged_orders AS (
    SELECT city,
           order_month,
           total_orders,
           LAG(total_orders) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY order_month ASC) AS prev_orders
    FROM monthly_orders
)
SELECT city,
       order_month AS month,
       total_orders AS orders,
       ROUND(((total_orders - prev_orders) / prev_orders) * 100, 2) AS percentage_change
FROM lagged_orders
ORDER BY city ASC, month ASC;
